description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Thresh''' throws his lantern to the target location over 0.5 seconds, lasting for 6 seconds while he remains nearby and granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of its surroundings. If '''Thresh''' moves too far away from the lantern, it returns back to him immediately.
description.text: Active: Thresh throws his lantern to the target location over 0.5 seconds, lasting for 6 seconds while he remains nearby and granting sight of its surroundings. If Thresh moves too far away from the lantern, it returns back to him immediately.

description2.raw: '''Thresh''' and the first allied champion to come near the lantern are granted a [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shield]] for 4 seconds. An ally can select the lantern while in proximity of it, [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashing]] to '''Thresh''' and gaining the shield.
description2.text: Thresh and the first allied champion to come near the lantern are granted a shield for 4 seconds. An ally can select the lantern while in proximity of it, dashing to Thresh and gaining the shield.

description3.raw: ''An ally cannot select the lantern while [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Immobilizing|An icon representing the keyword Immobilize]] [[:Crowd_control#Immobilizing|immobilized]], [[File:Grounded icon.png|20px|link=Ground|An icon representing the keyword Ground]] [[:Ground|grounded]], or [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Silence|An icon representing the keyword Silence]] [[:Silence|silenced]]. The lantern will not expire from '''Thresh''' moving too far away if he is dashing with [[File:Thresh Deathly Leap.png|20xpx|border|link=Thresh#Deathly Leap|An icon for Thresh's ability Deathly Leap]] [[Thresh#Deathly Leap|Deathly Leap]].''
description3.text: An ally cannot select the lantern while immobilized, grounded, or silenced. The lantern will not expire from Thresh moving too far away if he is dashing with Deathly Leap.

notes.raw: * The dashing ally will track '''Thresh''' if he changes locations. ** They will dash to '''Thresh's''' previous location if he is too far away or moves beyond 2200 units. * The lantern is considered a unit and can be targeted by an allied [[File:Teleport.png|20xpx|border|link=Teleport|An icon representing Teleport]] [[Teleport]], ''[[File:Jax Leap Strike.png|20xpx|border|link=Jax#Leap Strike|An icon for Jax's ability Leap Strike]] [[Jax#Leap Strike|Leap Strike]]'', ''[[File:Katarina Shunpo.png|20xpx|border|link=Katarina#Shunpo|An icon for Katarina's ability Shunpo]] [[Katarina#Shunpo|Shunpo]]'', and ''[[File:Lee Sin Safeguard.png|20xpx|border|link=Lee Sin#Safeguard|An icon for Lee Sin's ability Safeguard]] [[Lee Sin#Safeguard|Safeguard]]''. ** It is [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] to enemies. ** The lantern blocks pathing of units like minions and champions. * The lantern's duration and maximum leash range are each displayed as a circle on the ground. * '''Thresh''' will gain ''Dark Passage's'' shield from moving out of leash range of the lantern. ** When the lantern returns to '''Thresh''', the first ally champion to come in contact with '''Thresh''' while he has ''Dark Passage's'' shield will also gain a shield as long as no other ally has the shield. * ''Dark Passage'' is special cased to trigger [[File:Guardian rune.png|20xpx|link=Guardian|An icon representing Guardian]] [[Guardian]].
notes.text:
The dashing ally will track Thresh if he changes locations.
* They will dash to Thresh's previous location if he is too far away or moves beyond 2200 units.
The lantern is considered a unit and can be targeted by an allied Teleport, Leap Strike, Shunpo, and Safeguard.
* It is untargetable to enemies.
* The lantern blocks pathing of units like minions and champions.
The lantern's duration and maximum leash range are each displayed as a circle on the ground.
Thresh will gain Dark Passage's shield from moving out of leash range of the lantern.
* When the lantern returns to Thresh, the first ally champion to come in contact with Thresh while he has Dark Passage's shield will also gain a shield as long as no other ally has the shield.
Dark Passage is special cased to trigger Guardian.
